04-15.solution: The job is \(30 \times 40 = 1200\) worker-days. In 25 days \(750\) are done, leaving \(450\). The 20 who stay work at \(125\%\), like \(25\) workers, so they need \(\frac{450}{25} = 18\) more days.

04-16.solution: The project is \(42 \times 35 = 1470\) man-days. In 21 days \(882\) are done, leaving \(588\) for 28 men: \(21\) more days, so it ends on day \(42\), \(7\) days after the planned day 35.

04-18.solution: Let there be \(n\) men, planned for 24 days. With 6 leaving after 8 days the job took 28 days: \(24n = 8n + 20(n - 6)\), so \(4n = 120\) and \(n = 30\).

04-29.solution: The task is \(54 \times 9 \times 20 = 9720\) man-hours. In 12 days \(5832\) are done, leaving \(3888\). 36 men at 12 hours a day do \(432\) a day, so they need \(\frac{3888}{432} = 9\) days.
